text:
arjun: Quick sync — Granite9B (FP16 -> Q4_0 and Q6_INT) onboarding summary and cost-vs-quality snapshot.

arjun: Ran a focused sweep across 3 quant configs (FP16 baseline, Q4_0, Q6_INT) on our chat/codex slices. Small sample (10k queries) but signal is consistent.

marta: can you paste the key numbers?

arjun: TL;DR:
- Q4_0: p50 latency +8%, p95 +12%, token cost -28%, helpfulness delta -0.6% absolute vs FP16, hallucination +0.2pp.
- Q6_INT: p50 latency +3%, p95 +6%, token cost -42%, helpfulness delta -1.9% abs, hallucination +1.1pp.

sam: wow cost drop on Q6 is nice but hallucination jump worries me.

arjun: exact numbers:
```
FP16 baseline: p50 63ms, p95 210ms, cost per 1k tokens $1.00, helpfulness 87.4%, hallucination 2.3%
Q4_0: p50 68ms, p95 235ms, cost per 1k tokens $0.72, helpfulness 86.8%, hallucination 2.5%
Q6_INT: p50 65ms, p95 222ms, cost per 1k tokens $0.58, helpfulness 85.5%, hallucination 3.4%
```

jess: What's our unit-econ impact assuming production mix (60% chat, 30% search rerank, 10% embedding) ?

arjun: rough blended delta vs FP16: Q4_0 saves ~22% on token spend; Q6_INT saves ~36%. Product impact: estimated revenue-impact neutral for Q4_0, risk of support uptick for Q6_INT given hallucination.

marta: quality regression is small on Q4_0 — within A/B noise? Stat tests?

arjun: did bootstrap CI on helpfulness: Q4_0 delta -0.6% (95% CI [-0.9, -0.3]) so likely real but small. Q6_INT delta -1.9% (95% CI [-2.4, -1.4]) — likely material.

sam: suggestions for routing/flagging?

arjun: proposal:
- Default to Q4_0 for chat and rerank (gives material cost savings, minimal quality delta).
- Use Q6_INT only for low-latency, cost-sensitive background tasks (e.g., embeddings batch jobs) behind a separate route.
- Add quick eval hooks: monitor helpfulness, hallucination, and key user intents. If hallucination rate increases >0.8pp from baseline, auto-fallback to FP16 for 5% of requests for 24h.

jess: for GTN/product: recommend canary 5% traffic for 7 days, tracked metrics: helpfulness, NPS from sampled users, support tickets, completion rate.

marta: also propose a targeted slice test — high-verbatim factual prompts, and code generation slice where hallucination matters more.

arjun: follow-ups:
- @marta: create the slice checklist & monitoring dashboard (ETA 2 days)
- @infra-bot: create canary route config: granite9b-q4_default (5% traffic) and granite9b-q6_batch (0% by default).
- @sam: prepare cost forecast for committed capacity assumptions.

infra-bot: canary route granite9b-q4_default created. qc pipeline scheduled.

sam: ack, will have forecast by EOD Thursday.

jess: I'll prep the GTM note recommending Q4_0 for wider rollout pending canary results. :thumbsup:

arjun: Thanks all. If canary looks stable we'll roll Q4_0 to 50% next sprint and keep Q6_INT off for prod chat.

marta: noted. adding a short doc with the CI tables and raw slice outputs to the onboarding folder.

arjun: linking raw logs here once uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3/granite9b/sweep-3223456789

sam: :eyes: will review tomorrow.

jess: sounds good.
